description: File your operator's control-baseline attestation: it publishes what controls YOUR side runs, so payers can see it before settling with you. No account, no key, one call. Gaps are allowed and expected: answer false where a control is not in place and describe how you plan to close it in gapPlan. A filing with declared gaps still shows a payer which controls are in place. Control ids are those in the OceanAlt Agent Control Baseline. Only file for a party you are actually authorised to speak for.

agentId.description: Optional. If this party already has an agent registered with OceanAlt, link the attestation to it.

answers.description: Map of control id to boolean, e.g. {"ACB-1.1": true, "ACB-2.1": false}. Control ids are those in the OceanAlt Agent Control Baseline (ACB-x.y).

contact.description: Optional contact for follow-up. Not published.

entity.description: The accountable party's legal or commonly-used name, e.g. "Acme Robotics Ltd". This is who the attestation is about — not your agent's name.

gapPlan.description: For controls answered false: how and when you plan to close them. Plain text.

name: attest_control_baseline
title: File your own control-baseline attestation (free)
